consumer: science knowledge pool governance chain (DatasetKind::Knowledge entries: bundle import gate + execution-side retrieval data plane)
title: Evorule science knowledge entry (knowledge dataset payload)
description: Statement-type science knowledge entries: propositions, definitions, axioms, theorems and prose statements. Zero-rewrite contract: statement, notation_zh and conditions carry source corpus text verbatim (selection only, no paraphrase); entries are never rewritten into equation form — equation-identity semantics belong to law_set entries. classification records the notation-face class from the pool census (X2 = formal statement without an equals sign; X1 = notation mixed with prose; X0 = prose only, no notation). dispute_mark carries disputed-axiom adjudication context verbatim (status, reason, accept/reject camps, full dispute detail); its presence marks a dual-state entry that must stay retrievable alongside mainstream content.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier from the science rules corpus (e.g. MATH-LOGIC-AX-01); doubles as the bundle entry_id.

name_zh.description: Chinese name or short statement, verbatim.

name_en.description: English name, verbatim; omitted when the corpus has none.

rule_type.description: Corpus rule type (axiom / definition / formula / theorem / ...), verbatim.

subdomain.description: Corpus subdomain, verbatim; omitted when absent.

classification.description: Notation-face class from the pool census (see x-classification-map.jsonl).

notation_zh.description: Formal notation, verbatim; omitted for X0 entries (prose only).

statement.description: Knowledge statement: corpus desc_zh when present, otherwise name_zh — verbatim selection, never rewritten.

conditions.description: Applicability conditions, verbatim; omitted when the corpus has none.

source_ref.description: Citation from the corpus, verbatim; omitted when absent.

detail.description: Full dispute record carried over verbatim (superset of the extracted fields, including alternatives and note).
